scope: Stage 3B-1 short-lived local node/edge activity carriers without event assignment or parameter update

representation.location: inside the unified Subject VM node/edge storage
representation.node_value: bounded signed executed-node output multiplied by a graph-owned eligibility gate
representation.edge_value: bounded signed actual edge transmission multiplied by a graph-owned eligibility gate
representation.sign_is: local computational direction only, not objective or subjective valence

lifecycle.decay: configured deterministic multiplicative decay by elapsed ticks
lifecycle.birth: inherit gates and participation flags but reset values and ages
lifecycle.death: clear values, ages and last-tick state
lifecycle.compaction: move local state with the stable owner
lifecycle.checkpoint: exact replay state; older Stage-3A payloads upgrade to empty local eligibility

causal_order.activity_mark: during activation after the actual bounded local value is known

forbidden: reward, valence, polarity, trust, interest or knowledge-value fields
weight, gate, state-retention or topology plasticity
future_boundary: A separately frozen later stage may combine historical continuous tokens, unsigned objective facts and still-live local eligibility through a generic modulator. No event is required to receive credit.
